description_text:

Our Advisory and Consulting services can help upfront with an application strategy or find the right places for your applications – whether it’s public, multi or hybrid cloud, or mainframe. And because we span across all mission-critical platforms, we can meet you wherever you are in your digital transformation journey, with 24/7 support when you need it. And that’s just the beginning.

Mainframe Senior Developer - AMS

Job Description

This role requires a highly skilled and experienced Senior Mainframe Developer with 10 - 12+ Years of specialized technical experience to support, maintain, and enhance a suite of mainframe applications. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in various skills in mainframe technologies along with Netron Frame Technology, middleware, databases, and DevOps practices, with a strong understanding of enterprise application support and acts as a technical lead, responsible for maintaining, enhancing, and supporting critical mainframe applications while guiding junior team members

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Mainframe applications using COBOL, CICS, IMS DB/DC, DB2, MQ and VSAM. Candidate should have experience in Netron Frame technology.
  • Experience in enterprise-level ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Service Manager, etc.) and their operational workflows.
  • Worked on waterfall and agile methodology projects; capable of handling - Incidents, Service Requests and Change Requests simultaneously.
  • Provide technical troubleshooting and resolution for complex application and integration.
  • Conduct performance tuning and optimization of Mainframe applications and database queries.
  • Develop technical documentation (Knowledge Base articles, SOPs) for business and support teams
  • Understand both functional and technical requirements and provide implementation/change options aligned with business needs.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: Extensive experience in mainframe application development, support and maintenance
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in mainframe technologies such as COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, IMS DC/DB, MQ and VSAM, Netron Frame Technology. Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Experience with version control systems and software development tools.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Shift Time - Rotational Shift - 24/7
